domains.name: Application
domains.covers: The program itself: launching, version, help, user identity, add-ons, AI assistant and app-wide utilities.

features.name: About InDesign
features.summary: Shows the version and licensing information for the installed application.

automation.notes: Application.version and Application.fullName expose the version without opening the dialog. Invoking it opens a modal dialog, which blocks an unattended script.

features.name: AI Assistant
features.summary: A conversational panel that carries out layout and text tasks described in plain language.

automation.notes: Inferred: no member in any held object model (2023 to 2026/21.5), no id in commands.json and no community script reaches the AI Assistant. It is a conversational panel backed by an online service.

features.name: Background Tasks panel
features.summary: Lists exports running in the background and their progress.

automation.notes: BackgroundTask.status takes TaskState (CANCELLED, CANCELLING, COMPLETED, QUEUED, RUNNING, WAITING). MenuAction 91382 also reaches it (id from the CS5 list).

features.name: Find Extensions on Exchange
features.summary: Opens Adobe Exchange to browse add-ons for InDesign.

automation.notes: Inferred: no member in any held object model (2023 to 2026/21.5), no id in commands.json and no community script reaches this menu item. It only opens the Adobe Exchange marketplace.

features.name: Generative AI features
features.summary: Firefly-backed features for generating images, expanding images, suggesting alt text and producing text variations.

automation.notes: Only the alt text step is exposed (2026/21.5): enabling autoGenerateAltText makes placed images get AI alt text, addAITagToAltText marks it, and altTextGenerationError flags failures. Image generation, image expansion and text variations have no member, command or community script.

features.name: Get notified
features.summary: Signs up for notifications about new features.

automation.notes: Inferred: no member in any held object model (2023 to 2026/21.5), no id in commands.json and no community script reaches this sign-up item. It concerns notifications about new features, not documents.

features.name: Layouts with hand gestures
features.summary: Draws frames and shapes from hand-drawn gestures that the application converts into objects.

automation.notes: Inferred: no member in any held object model (2023 to 2026/21.5), no id in commands.json and no community script reaches gesture drawing. GeneralPreference.enableMultiTouchGestures concerns trackpad gestures, not this feature.

features.name: InDesign Help
features.summary: Opens Adobe's online help for the application.

features.name: Home screen
features.summary: The start screen shown when no document is open, listing recent files and presets for new documents.

automation.notes: homeScreenVisible reports or sets whether the Home screen is showing. MenuAction 107777 also reaches it (id from the CS5 list).

features.name: Manage Extensions
features.summary: Opened the extension manager for installed add-ons in older releases.

automation.notes: Present in the CS5 list; current releases manage add-ons through the Creative Cloud app.

features.name: Modal state
features.summary: Reports whether a modal dialog or alert is currently open, which blocks most scripting.

features.name: Quit InDesign
features.summary: Closes the application; on macOS the command sits in the InDesign menu as Quit InDesign.

automation.notes: quit() takes a SaveOptions value for open documents. MenuAction 267 also reaches it (id from the CS5 list).

features.name: Reset preferences
features.summary: Restores default preferences by holding a key combination while the application starts.

automation.notes: Added in 2025 (20.0): resets preferences to defaults from a script instead of the startup key combination. Not run.

features.name: InDesign Server
features.summary: A headless edition of InDesign that runs scripts and plug-ins on a server for automated publishing.

automation.notes: InDesign Server has no UI: every job is a script run through its SOAP interface or command line against the same object model, so features reach it only through dom routes. InDesign Server does not support MenuActions; only the object model is available there.

features.name: Touch workspace
features.summary: A simplified interface for touch-screen Windows devices.

features.name: Updates
features.summary: Checks Creative Cloud for application updates.

features.name: User
features.summary: Sets the user name and colour that label notes, tracked changes and InCopy check-outs.

automation.notes: Application.userColor takes InCopyUIColors (AMBER, AQUA, BLACK, BLUE, BLUEBERRY, BRICK_RED, BROWN, BURGUNDY, CANARY, CARNATION, CHARCOAL, CIRRUS, CORNSTARCH, CUTE_TEAL, CYAN, DARK_BLUE, DARK_GREEN, EGGPLANT, ELECTROLYTE, ETHER, FIESTA, FOREST, FUCHSIA, GOLD, GRAPE, GRAPHITE, GRASS_GREEN, GRAY, GREEN, GRID_BLUE, GRID_GREEN, GRID_ORANGE, GUNMETAL, IRIS, JADE, LAVENDER, LEMON, LICHEN, LIGHT_BLUE, LIGHT_GRAY, LIGHT_OLIVE, LIME, LIPSTICK, MAGENTA, MIDNIGHT, MOCHA, MUSTARD, OCHRE, OLIVE_GREEN, ORANGE, PEACH, PINK, POWDER, PURPLE, RED, SLATE, SMOKE, SULPHUR, TAN, TEAL, ULTRAMARINE, VIOLET, WHEAT, WHITE, YELLOW). MenuAction 99073 also reaches it (id from the CS5 list).

features.name: Export User Settings
features.summary: Saves preferences, workspaces and shortcut sets to a file so they can be moved to another machine.

automation.notes: Added in 2025 (20.0). Takes a file path string and exports the customised settings as the menu command does. Not run.

features.name: Import User Settings
features.summary: Loads a previously exported settings file into this installation.

automation.notes: Added in 2025 (20.0). Takes the path of a previously exported settings file. Not run; some settings may only apply after a restart.

features.name: Plug-ins (UXP)
features.summary: Plugins built on Adobe's UXP platform add panels and commands to the application.

automation.notes: Inferred: no member in any held object model (2023 to 2026/21.5), no id in commands.json and no community script reaches installing or loading UXP plugins. Plugins are installed through Creative Cloud or the UXP Developer Tool; once loaded they use the same object model.

features.name: Application version
features.summary: The running application reports its version number, install path and UI locale to scripts.

automation.notes: Application.locale takes Locale (ARABIC_LOCALE, CZECH_LOCALE, DANISH_LOCALE, ENGLISH_LOCALE, FINNISH_LOCALE, FRENCH_LOCALE, GERMAN_LOCALE, GREEK_LOCALE, HEBREW_LOCALE, HUNGARIAN_LOCALE, INTERNATIONAL_ENGLISH_LOCALE, ITALIAN_LOCALE, JAPANESE_LOCALE, KOREAN_LOCALE, POLISH_LOCALE, PORTUGUESE_LOCALE, ROMANIAN_LOCALE, RUSSIAN_LOCALE, SIMPLIFIED_CHINESE_LOCALE, SPANISH_LOCALE, SWEDISH_LOCALE, TRADITIONAL_CHINESE_LOCALE, TURKISH_LOCALE, UKRAINIAN_LOCALE).

domains.name: Documents
domains.covers: Creating, opening, saving, closing and configuring whole documents, including size, intent, bleed, slug and windows onto them.

features.name: Adjust Layout
features.summary: Resizes pages and repositions or scales content to fit a new page size or margins.

features.name: Adjust Font Size
features.summary: Scales type when the page changes size.

features.name: Adjust Locked Content
features.summary: Lets locked objects move and resize too.

features.name: Auto-Adjust Margins to Page Size Changes
features.summary: Scales margins with the page.

features.name: Enable Adjust Layout
features.summary: Turns automatic layout adjustment on.

features.name: Set Font Size Limits
features.summary: Keeps adjusted type between a minimum and maximum size.

features.name: Binding direction
features.summary: Sets whether pages bind on the left or right, which flips spread order for right-to-left publications.

automation.notes: DocumentPreference.pageBinding takes PageBindingOptions (DEFAULT_VALUE, LEFT_TO_RIGHT, RIGHT_TO_LEFT).

features.name: Bleed
features.summary: Defines the area outside the trim that printed artwork may extend into.

features.name: Cascade
features.summary: Stacks open document windows so each title bar is visible.

automation.notes: MenuAction 284 also reaches it (id from the CS5 list).

features.name: Close
features.summary: Closes the active document window, prompting to save unsaved changes.

automation.notes: close(saving, savingIn) takes a SaveOptions value. MenuAction 263 also reaches it (id from the CS5 list). MenuAction 327 also reaches it (id from the CS5 list).

features.name: Close All

automation.notes: MenuAction 325 also reaches it (id from the CS5 list).

features.name: Cloud document version history
features.summary: Cloud documents keep a version history that can be browsed and restored.

automation.notes: No object-model member lists, opens or restores the versions of a cloud document; version history is browsed and restored only in InDesign's Version History panel. Document.revertToProject, which the atlas cites, reverts to a Version Cue version, not a cloud document version.

features.name: Consolidate All Windows
features.summary: Gathers floating document windows into tabs in one window.

features.name: Adjust Layout (document setup)

features.name: Bleed (document setup)

features.name: Number of Pages (document setup)

features.name: Orientation (document setup)

features.name: Page Size (document setup)
features.summary: Changes the page size.

features.name: Slug (document setup)

features.name: Start Page # (document setup)

features.name: Document

features.name: Document Presets

features.name: File Info

automation.notes: MenuAction 75265 also reaches it (id from the CS5 list).

features.name: Intent

features.name: Adjust Layout (margins)

features.name: Open Recent
features.summary: Lists recently opened files for quick reopening.

automation.notes: The object model can only remove entries from the recent list, not read it. Limit: scripts cannot read the File > Open Recent list; Application.removeFileFromRecentFiles only removes an entry (run_file_command remove_from_recent). Reopening a file needs its path (open_document).

features.name: Orientation
features.summary: Switches pages between portrait and landscape.

automation.notes: DocumentPreference.pageOrientation takes PageOrientation (LANDSCAPE, PORTRAIT).

features.name: Page size
features.summary: Sets the width and height of the document's pages, from a named size or custom values.

features.name: Number of pages
features.summary: Sets how many pages the document contains.

features.name: Pages per spread
features.summary: Spreads can hold up to ten pages for gatefolds and fold-outs.

automation.notes: Spread page counts are changed by adding pages to a spread with shuffling turned off (Spread.allowPageShuffle).

features.name: Primary Text Frame
features.summary: Adds a threaded text frame on the parent page that new pages inherit for flowing text.

automation.notes: MasterSpread.primaryTextFrame takes NothingEnum (NOTHING).

features.name: Document recovery
features.summary: Reopens unsaved work from automatic recovery data after a crash.

automation.notes: Recovery runs at launch; Document.recovered reports whether a document came from recovery data. Limit: document recovery runs when InDesign starts after a crash and cannot be triggered by a script; Document.recovered only reports whether an open document came from recovery data (manage_file_info get).

features.name: Document Recovery Data
features.summary: Sets the folder where the application stores recovery data, in File Handling preferences.

automation.notes: Inferred: no member in any held object model (2023 to 2026/21.5), no id in commands.json and no community script reaches the recovery data folder. GeneralPreference.temporaryFolder is the separate temporary-files location.

features.name: Revert

features.name: Save as cloud document

features.name: Tile
features.summary: Arranges open document windows side by side.

automation.notes: MenuAction 285 also reaches it (id from the CS5 list).

features.name: Save for earlier versions
features.summary: Older releases cannot open newer documents, so files are exported as IDML for backward compatibility.

automation.notes: Export with ExportFormat.INDESIGN_MARKUP.

features.name: Zero point
features.summary: Sets where ruler measurements start, either per page, per spread or on the spine.

automation.notes: ViewPreference.rulerOrigin takes RulerOrigin (PAGE_ORIGIN, SPINE_ORIGIN, SPREAD_ORIGIN). MenuAction 13364, 13365, 13366, 118803 also reaches it (id from the CS5 list).

features.name: Auto Style
features.summary: Uses AI to apply a style pack to unformatted text based on its structure.

automation.notes: Menu-only: app.menuActions.itemByName("Auto Style").invoke(). The title comes from Adobe's menu documentation, not from commands.json (the CS5-era list predates it), so it is unverified and locale-dependent; confirm by enumerating app.menuActions and check enabled before invoking. Uses a generative AI service and the active style pack; needs selected text or a text frame. Type > Auto Style sends the text to a generative AI service and applies the active style pack. The 2023-2026 object model has no method for it; ClipboardPreference.showAutoStyleOption (2024+) only shows the paste option. The command list has no menu-action id for it, and the atlas route, MenuActions.itemByName("Auto Style"), relies on an unverified, localized title.

features.name: Sort Recent Fonts List Alphabetically

automation.notes: Menu-only: app.menuActions.itemByName("Sort Recent Fonts List Alphabetically").invoke(). The title comes from Adobe's menu documentation, not from commands.json (the CS5-era list predates it), so it is unverified and locale-dependent; confirm by enumerating app.menuActions and check enabled before invoking. A toggle; checked reports its state. It is a Type menu toggle that only changes how InDesign's font menus look. No object-model property holds it in the 2023-2026 object model, and the command list has no menu-action id for it. The atlas route, MenuActions.itemByName("Sort Recent Fonts List Alphabetically"), relies on an unverified, localized menu title, and module tools invoke menu actions only by ids from the command list.
